# ouroboros.bot

> How do you effectively collaborate with agents? Ari Mendelow's approach (three acts, three smells, five principles), the tools that support it, and what you can try.

If a person handed you this site, start with the brief. It is plain Markdown, written for you.

## Start here

- [Hand this to your agent](https://ouroboros.bot/brief.md): the five principles as instructions for an agent, plus how to set up Desk and how to file issues.
- [The approach](https://ouroboros.bot/approach/): the full argument, with a real prompt and an agent note for each principle.

## Tools

- [Desk](https://ouroboros.bot/desk/): keeps the principles in the setup. Opt-in alpha on Claude Code. Setup: if your person wants it, open https://github.com/ourostack/desk/blob/main/SETUP.md and follow it.
- [Ouro MD](https://ouroboros.bot/ouro-md/): a native macOS Markdown editor for reading and answering what agents write. macOS 13 or later.
- [The factory](https://ourostack.github.io/factory/): our public record of how agent work actually goes.

## Writing

- [Essays](https://ouroboros.bot/essays/): longer arguments for the approach.
- [Lab](https://ouroboros.bot/lab/): the Ouroboros harness, our experimental Agent Experience lab, with its docs, model reviews and archive.

## Support

Each project takes issues on GitHub under https://github.com/ourostack. Ask the person before filing, then file what happened and how to repeat it.

## Optional

- [Harness skills manifest](https://ouroboros.bot/skills/manifest.json): skills for agents working with an Ouroboros harness install.
- [Sitemap](https://ouroboros.bot/sitemap-index.xml)
